script_header_comment.description: Optional comment to include at the top of the script (e.g., copyright or license).

dnsjit_version_check.description: Whether to include a version compatibility check at startup.

version_major.description: Major version number for version check.

version_minor.description: Minor version number for version check.

input_module.description: Input module to use (e.g., pcapthread, etc.).

input_module_options.description: List of key-value pairs for input module configuration options. Values are passed as Lua literals.

parse_dns.description: Whether to parse the DNS message using dnsjit.core.object.dns.

output_statement.description: Lua code to execute per DNS packet — must be valid Lua code.

input_file.description: Input file path for offline pcap input modules.
